definitions.explanation: To put something under the ground or cover it.

definitions.gloss: to fill in, to fill up
definitions.explanation: To make something full or complete.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{種|たね}を{埋|う}めた。
examples.english: I buried seeds in the garden.

notes:
{埋|う}める means to bury or fill in.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {埋|う}める (transitive): to bury
- {埋|う}まる (intransitive): to be buried

COMMON USES:
- {穴|あな}を{埋|う}める: to fill a hole
- {空白|くうはく}を{埋|う}める: to fill blanks
- {差|さ}を{埋|う}める: to close a gap
